assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setback), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The open-data catalogue, data-minimization rules, and AI-service registration mechanisms are conceptual recommendations aligned with the Data Security Law and the Public Data Resource Pilot Notice; the exact catalogue scope, tiering, and authorization workflow must be confirmed by the competent data authority.
assumptions.impact: Data-commons service scenarios (SC-01 to SC-12) can be reviewed as design concepts; the open-data inventory and authorization procedures require official confirmation before operation.

assumptions.statement: The site and key-area boundaries are provisional coarse boundaries derived from the announcement's text extents and area constraints; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area metrics, spatial structures, and phasing extents are provisional and must be recalculated when the official boundary is released.
